counting_rules: Only EXECUTED money movements count. Pending auths, declines, fraud YES/NO prompts, Zelle requests, AutoPay SETUP notices, scheduled (future) payments, statements, reminders, OTPs and non-bank noise move NO ledger.
The exact-duplicate BofA $77.30 TARGET SMS appears twice; it must be counted ONCE (dedupe).
Chase debit card 882 draws from acct 9384: card-882 activity is included in the 9384 ledger; row '882' is the card-level subset (its balance mirrors acct 9384).
Card 9111: expected_final_balance = outstanding owed (limit 4200 - available credit). Purchases=debits, payments/refunds=credits.

expected_accounts.note: Debit card subset of acct 9384; final balance mirrors 9384.
